# M5 reproducibility

*Generated by `python -m lanegame.experiments.rl.m5 reproduce`. The full file list with SHA-256 is `results/m5/inventory_files.json.gz`. Every network identity is in `results/m5/inventory.json`.*

- The protocol is `docs/m5/m5_preregistration.md`, version 1 (SHA-256 `21e35e074cdd2628e2c4816ccc7dab4b13a62e77a803fa8936027cf5bcb396e8`). Its amendment chain is in `results/m5/preregistration.json`.
- The code at generation has sources SHA-256 `7ebc49cac49a3b747cace707a2ce1f4b65d6b225b1413ad8e202c38db8266896` over 390 files, at commit `312d118d949a52bbf66ad8516920375643d8ff4c` with a dirty working tree.
- The sp arm uses `GameConfig.m45_calibrated()`. The om arm and every attacker use `m45_calibrated(obs_last_action=True)`.
- The seed roots are pairs [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5], TRAIN_SEED 70000, BENCH_ROOT 70050, CURVE_ROOT 70100, HIST_ROOT 70150, H2H_ROOT 70200, FAMILY_ROOT 70300, BATTERY_STATE_ROOT 70400, BATTERY_ROLL_ROOT 70450, CELL_ROOT 70500, LANE_EXIT_ROOT 70550, ATTACK_TRAIN_ROOT 70600, ATTACK_EVAL_ROOT 70700, READY_ROOT 70800, TRACE_ROOT 70900.
- `TRACE_ROOT` 70,900 is reserved and unused, because the traces replay games of the evaluation cells.

## Two levels of reproduction

1. **From the saved records.** `prereg_check`, `train_check`, `attack_check`, `analyse` and `report` re-derive every table in minutes, with no training and no game. They need the git-ignored records and run summaries listed below.
2. **The campaign.** Run the stages below in order, each behind its approval flag. The campaign stages took 36.2 h on six workers, plus the readiness checks. With the same code and seeds each stage reproduces bit for bit. Readiness parts R4, A1 and C1 test that for training and the attackers.

## Stages

| stage | command | produces |
|---|---|---|
| prereg_check | `python -m lanegame.experiments.rl.m5 prereg_check --workers 6` | verifies the amendment chain; the document must be the active version |
| M5a readiness | `python -m lanegame.experiments.rl.m5 ready --workers 6` | R0-R10 (results/m5/readiness.json) |
| correction pass and later readiness | `python -m lanegame.experiments.rl.m5 corrections --workers 6` | A1-A4, B1 (battery smoke), C1 (attacker smoke) (results/m5/corrections_readiness.json) |
| M5b training | `python -m lanegame.experiments.rl.m5 train --confirm-m5-train --workers 6` | 12 runs x 32,768,000 (train/main/<arm>/s<s>/) |
| training check | `python -m lanegame.experiments.rl.m5 train_check --workers 6` | results/m5/train_main.json (health, identities) |
| M5b monitoring | `python -m lanegame.experiments.rl.m5 monitor --confirm-m5-eval --workers 6` | learning curves and history games (eval/curve, eval/history) |
| M5d families | `python -m lanegame.experiments.rl.m5 families --confirm-m5-eval --workers 6` | opponent families, head to head, midpoints (eval/) |
| M5c battery | `python -m lanegame.experiments.rl.m5 battery --confirm-m5-eval --workers 6` | the M4.5c battery on 12 finals (battery/) |
| M5c 150-turn re-runs | `python -m lanegame.experiments.rl.m5 battery_extend --confirm-m5-eval --workers 6` | exception 3 for every failed validation |
| M5c cells | `python -m lanegame.experiments.rl.m5 cells --confirm-m5-eval --workers 6` | the M4 limitation families (cells/) |
| M5d core attackers | `python -m lanegame.experiments.rl.m5 attackers --confirm-m5-attackers --workers 6` | 12 x 8,192,000 (attack/main/<kind>_s<s>/), then attack_check |
| attacker check | `python -m lanegame.experiments.rl.m5 attack_check --workers 6` | results/m5/attack_check_main.json |
| M5d attacker evaluation | `python -m lanegame.experiments.rl.m5 attack_eval --confirm-m5-attackers --workers 6` | 36 cells x 128 pairs x 500 turns (attack/eval/main/) |
| analysis | `python -m lanegame.experiments.rl.m5 analyse --workers 6` | results/m5/analysis_main.json, monitoring_main.json, strategic_main.json |
| traces (exploratory) | `python -m lanegame.experiments.rl.m5 traces --workers 6` | 15 viewer recordings (results/m5/traces/) |
| attacker behaviour (exploratory) | `python -m lanegame.experiments.rl.m5 attack_behaviour --workers 6` | results/m5/attack_behaviour.json |
| report | `python -m lanegame.experiments.rl.m5 report --workers 6` | results/m5/report.md |
| reproducibility | `python -m lanegame.experiments.rl.m5 reproduce --workers 6` | this inventory |

## Measured wall time

| stage | wall h |
|---|---|
| M5b training | 10.90 |
| M5b monitor | 0.56 |
| M5d families | 1.87 |
| M5c battery | 8.73 |
| M5c cells | 2.11 |
| M5c battery_extend | 5.58 |
| M5d core attackers | 5.96 |
| M5d attacker evaluation | 0.52 |
| all campaign stages | 36.20 |
